summary_md: **minus1ms ([@minus1ms](https://x.com/minus1ms/status/2115581732431024376))** built **Phrasebook**, a free Claude Code hook that bans phrases you list (e.g. "load-bearing"); if one slips into a reply, Claude resends it reworded. Installable from the minus1ms-dev/phrasebook plugin marketplace.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - minus1ms-dev/phrasebook: Claude Code plugin: ban phrases Claude overuses (load-bearing, you're absolutely right, delve...). It rewords instead.

relevance: A tiny, concrete example of using harness hooks to enforce style rules that CLAUDE.md alone does not.
